otp_sent: Verification code sent to your email.
passkey_email_hint: Enter your registered email above to use a passkey, or leave it empty to sign in with a discoverable passkey.
bind_hint: Type /link in-game to generate a one-time bind code.

op_approved: Approved — enter the code from your email.
setup_invalid_subtitle: This setup link is invalid or has already been used
setup_invalid_hint_suffix: on the server to get a fresh setup link, or head to the sign-in page.
setup_email_desc: We'll save this address for your account. You can configure email delivery (SMTP) and verify it later from Settings — it isn't required to finish setup.
setup_passkey_desc: Create a passkey with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN. It's how you'll sign in to the console — required to finish setup.
session_ended_notice: Your session expired or was revoked. Sign in again to go back to the page you were on.
